ELKID-TIME.title: Time
ELKID-TIME.description:
Gained mostly from [gold]SLOW[/gold] card halves. In [gold]Fast[/gold] mode, dual cards spend 1 Time to play their [gold]FAST[/gold] half.
Max 5. Resets each combat.
ELKID-FAST_MODE.title: Fast / Slow
ELKID-FAST_MODE.description:
[gold]Right-click[/gold] a dual card in your hand to make just that card Fast, or use the button next to your Energy to make all of them Fast.
A Fast card spends 1 [aqua]Time[/aqua] to play its [gold]FAST[/gold] half. When Time runs out, cards go back to [gold]SLOW[/gold].
ELKID-BLINK.title: Blink
ELKID-BLINK.description: Gain that much [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Vigor[/gold]: your next Attack deals that much additional damage.
